title: Avoid simple column aggregate name display allocation
description: Replace simple_column_aggregate_projection dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Simple column aggregate projection detection no longer builds uppercase display names
COUNT star and COUNT column behavior remains unchanged
SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, STRING_AGG, and GROUP_CONCAT behavior remains unchanged
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple aggregate check

notes: The helper directly matches single-part ObjectName values case-insensitively.
simple_column_aggregate_projection now branches on direct helper checks instead of matching an allocated uppercase String.
The later group-by column aggregate path still has its own name allocation and remains a next-task candidate.
